title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function. This penalty term is controlled by the regularization coefficient, lambda.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: As the regularization coefficient lambda increases, the penalty for large weights in the model also increases. This can lead to a reduction in model complexity.

title: Impact on Variance
text: Increasing lambda typically reduces the variance of the model because it discourages the model from fitting the noise in the training data.
